newsitem.title: UK: Sainsbury eyes more US acquisitions -paper.
newsitem.headline: Sainsbury eyes more US acquisitions -paper.

text.p: British supermarket retailer J. Sainsbury Plc sees scope to add to Shaws, its regional supermarket chain in the U.S., the Times said.

The newspaper cited joint chief executive David Bremner as saying consolidation among U.S. food retailers offered opportunities for more acquisitions to speed up its expansion. Any purchase would be in addition to Sainsbury's plans to open up to 12 Shaws a year, the paper said.
Bremner said the relationship with Giant Food Inc, the store group in which Sainsbury has a 20 percent stake, is being developed, the Times reported.
